hooks.name: Patch Litter Scan
hooks.description: Scans the working tree for *.rej / *.orig files — the fingerprint of a partially applied patch, as left by an interrupted delegated agent on 2026-09-22 (a corrupted embedded_vnc_types.rs caught only when verify.sh failed minutes later). Command action on Stop, so it costs no credits; its stdout is not forwarded on Stop, so it appends to the shared target/.kiro-session-report channel that Session Report (deliver) prints on the next UserPromptSubmit. Deliberately does NOT flag "changed but not in the edit journal" — that signal is normal in a shared checkout and cost five wasted loops on 2026-09-06. Silent when the tree is clean; fails open. Logic: bin/patch-litter-scan.sh.
